verdict.rationale: The README gives one-line installs that plausibly take a developer from nothing to an installed skill within minutes: `npx skills add yylo-dev/yylo-skills` interactively, a no-prompt install-all for Claude Code, Codex and Pi, and a single-skill install with `--skill wiki-yylo`. A `yy skills install` path also exists. However, nothing documents a timed quickstart or shows the installed skill actually working, and several skills depend on the separate `yy` CLI and Ledger, whose setup isn't covered. missing for 10: a dedicated quickstart with a time-to-value claim, documented prerequisites (Node/npx, `yy` CLI and Ledger setup), a step verifying the skill works after install, independent hands-on corroboration.
